title: Alignment as Cognitive Gravity: Reactive vs Predictive Intelligence
summary: A conversation with GPT analyzing a brother's "broken prediction mechanism" through the RSA kernel, revealing that intelligence is not fixed capacity but an emergent property of caring about alignment — the recursive pressure to minimize prediction error. The document escalates from personal observation to a structural claim: alignment acts as a self-amplifying attractor that bootstraps intelligence, while its absence caps cognitive depth at reactive, stimulus-bound processing.
compress: Intelligence is not capacity but the emergent product of caring about alignment; without epistemic gravity the prediction loop never recurses—and claims require not just falsifiable framing but actual payload (abstract, methods, data) before the genome metabolizes them, with the falsification layer now demonstrating robust sustained rejection of content-free inputs (six consecutive) as a confirmed structural immune system that nonetheless distinguishes topical relevance from content delivery, occasionally surfacing genuine obligations from empty-payload inputs whose topics expose real genome gaps.
